## liboqs

### Release 0.17.0 — round 3 algorithm inclusion and essential items

Rodrigo summarised the current release targets using the prioritisation board. The 0.17.0 release is scoped around completing round 3 on-ramp algorithm inclusion, deprecating Classic McEliece by default, and updating HQC to its latest spec version.

**FAEST ([PR #2592](https://github.com/open-quantum-safe/liboqs/pull/2592)):** Norman is the lead on this PR. He has rebased and incorporated Michael's preparatory work. The main remaining step is moving the metadata file into the upstream FAEST repository. Norman noted one CI job timed out, likely due to the MemOpt build being slow; Michael suggested excluding FAEST from that job for now (there is an existing mechanism to skip algorithms by name) and opening a follow-on issue to restore coverage later. The team agreed to focus first on getting FAEST out of draft and ready for review, and to address the meta-file upstream move in parallel or as a subsequent PR — consistent with the precedent set for QR-UOV. With two weeks until the TSC meeting deadline, Norm will aim to have the PR in review-ready state within the week.

**HQC update ([issue #2670](https://github.com/open-quantum-safe/liboqs/issues/2670), [PR #2587](https://github.com/open-quantum-safe/liboqs/pull/2587)):** Bruce confirmed that the x86-optimised build and spec update are being handled together in one branch. A security issue in the upstream HQC repository has also surfaced ([issue #2684](https://github.com/open-quantum-safe/liboqs/issues/2684)); Bruce noted that since HQC is not yet Tier 1, there is some leeway, and the finding may fall outside the documented liboqs threat model. Rodrigo will use the security tracking infrastructure to loop in the upstream HQC team, who have previously expressed willingness to support integration. Bruce expects to complete this batch of work by end of week.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Action (Norman):** Exclude FAEST from the MemOpt CI job, move [PR #2592](https://github.com/open-quantum-safe/liboqs/pull/2592) out of draft, and aim to have it ready for review within the week; move the metadata file to the upstream repo in parallel or as a follow-on.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Action (Bruce):** Complete the HQC spec update, x86 optimised build, and security fix batch ([issue #2670](https://github.com/open-quantum-safe/liboqs/issues/2670), [PR #2587](https://github.com/open-quantum-safe/liboqs/pull/2587)) by end of week.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Action (Rodrigo):** Contact the upstream HQC team via the security tracking infrastructure regarding [issue #2684](https://github.com/open-quantum-safe/liboqs/issues/2684).

### clang-format ([PR #2649](https://github.com/open-quantum-safe/liboqs/pull/2649))

There was brief discussion on whether to include the clang-format migration in 0.17.0 or defer it. Michael favoured including it to have a clean release; Rodrigo and Owen noted it would need to be applied after FAEST lands to avoid forcing open PRs to resolve formatting conflicts. The consensus was to include it as the last step before the 0.17.0 release. Owen agreed this timing makes sense.
